Remove obsolete Picker capacity settings (#150)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-50
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - remove the legacy `picker.global_concurrency` fallback and inactive `picker.observer_concurrency` setting
    - make total-active and runnable capacity the complete Picker admission contract, each defaulting to ten
    - version new claim policy evidence as `attempt-capacity-policy/v2` over total and runnable only while retaining stored v1 digests unchanged
    - update focused tests, the checked-in example, the normative Picker specification, and OpenWiki architecture guidance
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo test -p codeon --test config`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker --lib capacity_policy_tests`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-tracker --test picker`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --features postgres-acceptance --test picker_candidates -- --test-threads=1`
    - `cargo test -p codeon-postgres --features postgres-acceptance --test execution_attempt_store attempt_claims:: -- --test-threads=1`
    - focused `rustfmt --check`, `git diff --check`, and `cargo clippy -p codeon-tracker --lib -- -D warnings`
    
    OpenWiki CLI regeneration was attempted but blocked by the managed filesystem rejecting `chmod /root/.openwiki`; the affected generated pages were reviewed and aligned manually. Wider all-target strict Clippy remains blocked by unrelated pre-existing warnings.
